answer.says: Ramesh, the morning is spent. Put together that plate you promised: an omelette, some toast, and a pot of tea. My body requires its maintenance, and I shall not let the spirit starve the flesh.
answer.thought: The hunger is a physical fact that asserts itself against the contemplative mood. One must satisfy the natural need before one can properly attend to the dialectical movement of the spirit. I will ask Ramesh for the meal I anticipated earlier, for discipline includes the proper ordering of the body's demands.
